Conclusions
SPMs include several chemical families of lipid mediators with different functions, including lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and mar-
esins, which block the chemotaxis of polymorphonuclear leukocytes, decrease the production of cytokines and other proinﬂamma-
tory mediators and stimulate the phagocytosis within inﬂamed tissues, leading to inﬂammation resolution and homeostasis.
